// TEMPORARY: dumps TypeScript-engine results for the Dart differential test.
import type { Adjustment, Bill, BillItem, Paise, Person } from '@/domain/types';
import { computeSettlement } from '../settle';

declare function require(name: string): { writeFileSync(path: string, data: string): void };
const { writeFileSync } = require('fs');

function makeRng(seed: number): () => number {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

function generateBill(seed: number): Bill {
  const rng = makeRng(seed);
  const int = (min: number, max: number) => min + Math.floor(rng() * (max - min + 1));
  const peopleCount = int(1, 8);
  const people: Person[] = Array.from({ length: peopleCount }, (_, i) => ({
    id: `person-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`,
    name: `Person ${i}`,
    colorIndex: i % 8,
    initials: `P${i}`,
  }));
  const itemCount = int(1, 20);
  const items: BillItem[] = Array.from({ length: itemCount }, (_, i) => {
    const lineTotal = int(100, 500000);
    return {
      id: `item-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`,
      name: `Item ${i}`,
      quantity: 1,
      unitPrice: lineTotal as Paise,
      lineTotal: lineTotal as Paise,
      source: 'manual' as const,
    };
  });
  const assignments: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const item of items) {
    const roll = rng();
    if (roll < 0.12) assignments[item.id] = [];
    else if (roll < 0.24) assignments[item.id] = people.map((p) => p.id);
    else {
      const count = int(1, peopleCount);
      const shuffled = [...people].sort(() => rng() - 0.5);
      assignments[item.id] = shuffled.slice(0, count).map((p) => p.id);
    }
  }
  const adjustmentCount = int(0, 4);
  const adjustments: Adjustment[] = Array.from({ length: adjustmentCount }, (_, i) => {
    const isPercent = rng() < 0.7;
    const isNegative = rng() < 0.2;
    return {
      id: `adj-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`,
      label: `Adjustment ${i}`,
      kind: isNegative ? ('discount' as const) : ('tax' as const),
      mode: isPercent ? ('percent' as const) : ('amount' as const),
      value: isPercent ? int(0, 3000) : int(0, 50000),
      order: i,
      base: rng() < 0.5 ? ('itemsSubtotal' as const) : ('runningTotal' as const),
      isNegative,
    };
  });
  return {
    id: `bill-${seed}`,
    title: `Generated ${seed}`,
    createdAt: '2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    people,
    items,
    assignments,
    adjustments,
  };
}

it('dumps the golden fixture', () => {
  const cases = [];
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= 200; seed++) {
    const bill = generateBill(seed);
    const s = computeSettlement(bill);
    cases.push({
      seed,
      bill: {
        people: bill.people.map((p) => p.id),
        items: bill.items.map((i) => [i.id, i.lineTotal, i.quantity]),
        assignments: bill.assignments,
        adjustments: bill.adjustments.map((a) => [
          a.id, a.mode, a.value, a.order, a.base, a.isNegative,
        ]),
      },
      expected: {
        itemsSubtotal: s.itemsSubtotal,
        grandTotal: s.grandTotal,
        unassignedAmount: s.unassignedAmount,
        unassignedItemIds: s.unassignedItemIds,
        reconciles: s.reconciles,
        adjustmentTotals: s.adjustmentTotals.map((a) => [a.adjustmentId, a.amount]),
        perPerson: s.perPerson.map((p) => [
          p.personId,
          p.subtotal,
          p.total,
          p.itemShares.map((i) => [i.itemId, i.share, i.assigneeCount]),
          p.adjustmentShares.map((a) => [a.adjustmentId, a.share]),
        ]),
      },
    });
  }
  writeFileSync(
    'test/fixtures/ts_engine_golden.json',
    JSON.stringify({ engine: 'v0.1-m1-engine (84e79c2)', cases }),
  );
  expect(cases).toHaveLength(200);
});
